Remote hearings are likely to pose difficulties for newly arrived migrants – see chapter 8

Concerns over unauthorised recording

18. Certain individuals may find it disturbing to appear “on film” for a variety of reasons, eg:
• Concern that someone, whether a participant in the hearing or a member of the public,
may make and use an unauthorised audio or video recording. This may be feared,
particularly by those whose cases concern domestic abuse or by asylum seekers from
oppressive regimes.
• For religious reasons, some people might object to a video recording being made. This
appears to be rare in the context of a court appearance, but could arise (eg some Amish
people do not allow personal photographs).
